import random
seed = int(input())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 8)
alpha = 'abc'[:rng.randint(2, 3)]
words = set()
while len(words) < n:
    words.add(''.join(rng.choice(alpha) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 6))))
words = sorted(words)
rng.shuffle(words)
print(n)
for w in words:
    print(w)
